page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ine.2xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon Sapphire Rapids processors running at a baseline frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application data. It lacks dedicated GPU hardware accelerators. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio make this instance suitable for compute-bound workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. Appropriate workloads include web serving, batch processing, microservices, and distributed component nodes where consistent CPU performance is prioritized over local storage speed or high memory capacity.
